Jonas / Hannah — summary from infra: 

Regions: currently supported US regions are: us-west-2 (primary), us-east-1 (secondary). No processing is routed outside the selected region unless the customer authorizes cross-region replication/backups; we can set replication to disabled.

Private/VPC options:
- VPC Peering: lightweight, network-level peering for hosted tenants, good for lower setup time but not full isolation.
- Private Deployment (VPC-hosted private control plane): we deploy a private instance into customer VPC with cross-account roles. Offers stronger isolation and dedicated capacity.
- On-prem packaged option: available for air-gapped needs (longer lead time).

KMS & key management: supports customer-managed keys (AWS KMS CMKs) and integration options for CloudHSM. Data at rest: AES-256; in transit: TLS 1.2+ enforced. We support bring-your-own-key for disk encryption and database-level encryption.

Audit & logging: we can provide per-request audit logs, token-level traces, and a 90/180/365-day retention policy configurable per contract. We can export logs to customer S3 or CloudWatch.

Lead time: Private deployment in a new VPC typically 3-5 weeks after PO + network runbook and completed connectivity tests. On-prem is 6-10 weeks depending on approvals.

I've attached a candidate diagram and a short KMS integration note.

Attachment: aurora_vpc_diagram.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: kms_integration_notes.txt (text/plain)

Let me know if you want me to redline the intake spreadsheet directly.

— Mateo
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference

Quick answers here:
- US hosting: we currently offer us-west-2 and us-east-1. No PII leaves the chosen region unless you ask us to enable cross-region replication.
- Private options: VPC peering, Private (customer VPC) deployment, and on-prem package. Private deployment supports customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS CMKs) and CloudHSM where required.
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit.
- Lead time: Private deployment ~3-5 weeks after PO and network runbook completion; on-prem longer (6–10 weeks).
- Logs: we can deliver audit logs to your S3 or CloudWatch and offer token-level traces for incident investigations.

Links and next steps:
- Shared folder with artifacts: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/aurora-2026-vpc-evidence
